LESSON: PACKAGED FOOD EDUCATION

Grade: Grade 3
Subject: HYGIENE AND NUTRITION ACTIVITIES
Strand: Safety Education
Topic 4.1: Packaged food Education

SECTION 1: WELCOME

Hello learner! Today we will learn about Packaged food Education. Read carefully, study the examples, do the practice, then try the revision quiz.

SECTION 2: WHAT YOU WILL LEARN

You will learn the key ideas about Packaged food Education and use them at home and at school.

SECTION 3: LEARN STEP BY STEP

Read about Packaged food Education with your parent or teacher. Say what it means in your own words.

SECTION 4: EXAMPLES

Example 1: At school, pick litter and put it in the bin. That cares for the environment.

Example 2: Wash your hands with soap before eating and after using the toilet.

Example 3: Name two foods you eat at home that help you grow strong.

SECTION 5: TRY THIS

1. Read the examples above again. Underline two new words or ideas about Packaged food Education.
2. Explain Packaged food Education to a parent or classmate using your own words and one Kenyan example.
3. Draw or write three things that show you understand Packaged food Education.
4. Complete the Work to do section, then attempt the Revision Quiz. Check Answers only after you finish.

SECTION 6: WORK TO DO (PRACTICE & REVISION)

1. Write five sentences about Packaged food Education. Use examples from your school, home, or market.
2. Answer this question in your exercise book: Why is Packaged food Education important to you?
3. Make a short oral presentation (about one minute) to your parent or teacher.
4. List three ways you will practise this topic this week.

SECTION 8: REMEMBER

1. Packaged food Education is important in everyday life.

Now complete the Revision Quiz. Open the Answers tab only after you finish.

— CBC Learn · Learner lesson
